title: OS Version String
description: The kernel and distribution version, the coarsest but most available signal. Recorded facts — Signal: OS Version String; Source: uname; Stability: high. Used by licensing, anti-fraud, forensics, and debugging to identify where code ran.
demo:
# OS Version String — runnable demo (python3)
# OS Version String - fingerprint stability (python3)
signals=24
stable=22
min_pct=85.0
pct=100.0*stable/signals
print("stable signals: %d/%d (%.1f%%)" % (stable, signals, pct))
print("RELIABLE FINGERPRINT" if pct >= min_pct else "TOO VOLATILE")
